steps.title: As you start getting close to …
steps.text: As you start getting close to taking on the quest, start planting your Belladonna seeds for a stack of Nightshade

steps.title: Complete Song of the Elves. — …
steps.text: Complete Song of the Elves. — a runite bar can be easily obtained by trading a pair of rune platelegs to the Nest (nice). — Reclaim your Iban's staff and upgrade it for the fight. — After you are done with it, you can start Perilous Moons and store the staff at Blue Moon if you think you might want it again.
